static_evidence.basis: Original ELF analysis and unmodified generated-original bodies; decompiler types are not ABI authority.

function_differential_verification.comparison: Logical return bits where defined, complete 32MiB RAM excluding explicitly reserved original ABI stack workspace, and ordered dependency checkpoints/traces. Reference input hashes remain unchanged.
function_differential_verification.garage_fixtures: Every first-free position and exhaustion; randomized occupancy; finite well-formed empty/single/multiple/200-node lists; head/middle/tail unlink; selection-field update branches; null guards; reset; freed-slot reselection and reinsertion with an explicitly fixture-initialized detached record.
function_differential_verification.catalog_fixtures: Nonempty sorted unique unsigned64 keys including high-bit extremes; counts 1/2/3/7/16/31/244, strides 8/16/264, root offset/mask decoding, found and missing rows. Price/mode arithmetic uses explicit raw-bit boundary fixtures.
function_differential_verification.float_fixtures: Both forwarding entries, signed zero, subnormals, infinities and NaN payloads; original source helper executes with initialized cache and with its initialization branch enabled.
function_differential_verification.bounded_mocked_dependencies: Existing eligibility and debit-body fixtures intercept their opaque callees. They do not prove construction, full incoming constructor argument forwarding, or complete purchases.

source_regressions.qualification: Source-only checks include exact list/reset store sequences; these are regressions, not an independent oracle.

integration_approval.qualification: The active request authorizes isolated recovery and verification only. Proof is not approval.
